title: Beetroot Powder: You Are Dosing the Wrong Number
description: The active compound is nitrate, not powder weight. The umbrella review puts the minimum effective dose around 6 mmol, roughly 372 mg of nitrate a day, sustained for more than three days. Read the panel for nitrate specifically, then check it against the research range. #BeetrootPowder #Nitrate #Endurance #SportsNutrition #FuelnFitHub
